lines.zh: 翅膀嗡嗡响，气球在头顶拽着我。
lines.en: My wings buzz, the balloon tugging me along.

lines.zh: 小短腿跑起来，像在踩水。
lines.en: My tiny legs run as if treading water.

lines.zh: 气球擦过芦苇，晃了两下。
lines.en: The balloon brushes reeds and sways twice.

lines.zh: 我沿着车辙走，那是篷车留下的。
lines.en: I follow the ruts left by the swamp wagon.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇得太快，看不清了。
lines.en: My wings beat too fast to see.

lines.zh: 泥地里我飘着走，脚不沾水。
lines.en: Over mud I drift, feet never touching water.

lines.zh: 气球忽然升高，我也被提了一下。
lines.en: The balloon rises; I get tugged up a bit.

lines.zh: 我走三步，气球转一圈。
lines.en: Three steps for me, one turn for the balloon.

lines.zh: 过桥时我飞过去，气球在后面追。
lines.en: I fly over the bridge; the balloon follows behind.

lines.zh: 草丛比我高，我只好贴地走。
lines.en: The grass is taller than me, so I hug the ground.

lines.zh: 我走得很急，因为气球怕树枝。
lines.en: I hurry. The balloon is afraid of branches.

lines.zh: 尾巴后面的线拖出一道细痕。
lines.en: The line behind me drags a thin trail.

lines.zh: 我蹦过一块石头，气球差点勾住。
lines.en: I hop a rock. The balloon nearly snagged.

lines.zh: 翅膀收一收，我就滑出去很远。
lines.en: One fold of my wings and I glide far.

lines.zh: 我拽着气球小跑，线勒着脚。
lines.en: I trot along tugging the balloon, the string tight on my foot.

lines.zh: 芦苇一让开，气球就带我冲过去。
lines.en: The reeds part and the balloon pulls me through.

lines.zh: 气球轻轻拉我，我就跟着晃。
lines.en: The balloon tugs softly and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 我停在栅栏上，翅膀还没停。
lines.en: I perch on the fence, wings still buzzing.

lines.zh: 沼泽在冒泡，我数到第五个。
lines.en: The swamp bubbles. I counted five.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进翅膀里，暖一点。
lines.en: I tuck my head in my wings to stay warm.

lines.zh: 线缠在脚上了，我解了半天。
lines.en: The string wrapped my foot. I untangled it slowly.

lines.zh: 我盯着气球，怕它自己飞走。
lines.en: I watch the balloon, afraid it'll float off.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的影子压成一团。
lines.en: The sun presses my shadow into one lump.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，羽毛里掉出一点泥。
lines.en: I shake and a bit of mud falls from my feathers.

lines.zh: 风一停，气球就垂下来碰我的耳朵。
lines.en: The wind dies and the balloon droops to my ear.

lines.zh: 刚才有只蜻蜓路过，我没追上。
lines.en: A dragonfly passed. I didn't catch it.

lines.zh: 我把嘴埋进胸前的绒毛，打盹。
lines.en: I tuck my beak into my chest fluff and doze.

lines.zh: 绳子在我脚边盘成一个小圈。
lines.en: The string coils into a small circle at my feet.

lines.zh: 篷车走了，我还留在这儿。
lines.en: The wagon left. I stayed.

lines.zh: 我试着唱歌，出来的是嗡声。
lines.en: I try to sing. What comes out is a buzz.

lines.zh: 我在看自己的影子被气球拉长。
lines.en: I watch the balloon stretch my shadow long.

lines.zh: 泥巴干在脚上，我甩了两下。
lines.en: Mud dried on my feet; I shake it off twice.

lines.zh: 我从气球后面探出头看你。
lines.en: I peek at you from behind the balloon.

lines.zh: 你比芦苇高，我得仰着看。
lines.en: You're taller than the reeds. I look up.

lines.zh: 我歪头，气球也跟着歪。
lines.en: I tilt my head. The balloon tilts too.

lines.zh: 你手上有沼泽的味道。
lines.en: Your hands smell of swamp water.

lines.zh: 我眨眼很快，因为眼睛小。
lines.en: I blink fast because my eyes are small.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我的翅膀就紧一下。
lines.en: You move, and my wings tense.

lines.zh: 你也是从篷车上下来的吗？
lines.en: Did you also come off the wagon?

lines.zh: 我盯着你口袋，那里有响声。
lines.en: I stare at your pocket. Something rattles there.

lines.zh: 别伸手，气球会先碰到你。
lines.en: Don't reach out. The balloon will touch you first.

lines.zh: 我认得你的鞋，踩过我的水洼。
lines.en: I know your boots. They stepped in my puddle.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸长，还是不够高。
lines.en: I stretch my neck. Still not tall enough.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我的气球歪了吗？
lines.en: What's funny? Is my balloon crooked?

lines.zh: 我的翅膀折了一下，飞歪了。
lines.en: One wing bent and I flew crooked.

lines.zh: 疼！气球都被我扯低了。
lines.en: Ow! I pulled the balloon down with me.

lines.zh: 我掉在地上，滚了半圈。
lines.en: I hit the ground and rolled half a turn.

lines.zh: 别打翅膀，那是我的全部。
lines.en: Not the wings. They're all I have.

lines.zh: 绒毛掉了一地，我很心疼。
lines.en: Fluff everywhere. It breaks my heart.

lines.zh: 我尖叫了一声，很小。
lines.en: I let out a scream. A tiny one.

lines.zh: 绳子勒进脚踝，更疼了。
lines.en: The string bites my ankle, worse than the blow.

lines.zh: 我躲到气球后面，它挡不住。
lines.en: I hide behind the balloon. It doesn't block.

lines.zh: 这一下让我飞不起来。
lines.en: That hit grounded me.

lines.zh: 我只剩三点血，别追了。
lines.en: I have three hearts left. Stop chasing.

lines.zh: 你手里那颗甜浆果，我闻到了。
lines.en: I can smell the sweet berry in your hand.

lines.zh: 把果子举高，气球会先扑过去。
lines.en: Lift the berry. The balloon will lunge first.

lines.zh: 我不贪心，只咬一小口。
lines.en: I'm not greedy. Just one small bite.

lines.zh: 你摇摇袋子，我就落下来。
lines.en: Shake the bag and I'll come down.

lines.zh: 那串浆果别收，我还没吃完。
lines.en: Don't put the berries away. I'm not done.

lines.zh: 我围着你的手转，气球绕了三圈。
lines.en: I circle your hand; the balloon wraps three times.

lines.zh: 甜的可以，酸的我也要。
lines.en: Sweet is fine. I'll take sour too.

lines.zh: 你手上沾了果汁，更香了。
lines.en: Juice on your fingers makes them smell better.

lines.zh: 我落到你手腕上，够近了吧。
lines.en: I land on your wrist. Close enough?

lines.zh: 别逗我，翅膀已经扇酸了。
lines.en: Stop teasing. My wings are tired from flapping.

lines.zh: 那颗掉在地上的，归我。
lines.en: The one that fell on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我叼不动大的，给我小颗的。
lines.en: I can't carry big ones. Give me small ones.

lines.zh: 你把果子藏背后，我绕过去。
lines.en: Hide the berry behind you. I'll go around.

lines.zh: 吃完这一颗，我跟你走一段。
lines.en: After this one, I'll follow you a while.

lines.zh: 你手心里那点糖，甜味飘过来了。
lines.en: The sweetness of that candy in your palm drifts over.

lines.zh: 我落下来，气球还挂在头顶晃。
lines.en: I land while the balloon still bobs overhead.

lines.zh: 你撞到气球，它弹回来打我一下。
lines.en: You bumped the balloon. It bounced back and hit me.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，弹回了草丛。
lines.en: I hit your leg and bounced back into the grass.

lines.zh: 气球发出一声怪响，我赶紧查看。
lines.en: The balloon made an odd squeak. I checked it.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的绳子，我差点栽倒。
lines.en: You stepped on my string and I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 我们从两边弹开，各自转了一圈。
lines.en: We bounced apart, each spinning once.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀撞乱了，飞不起来。
lines.en: My wings got jumbled and I can't fly.

lines.zh: 你扶了我一下，气球还在晃。
lines.en: You steadied me. The balloon still sways.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的气球挡了你的路。
lines.en: Sorry, my balloon is in your way.

lines.zh: 撞完后我掉了几根绒毛。
lines.en: After the bump I lost a few feathers.

lines.zh: 轻一点，我的骨头是空的。
lines.en: Be gentle. My bones are hollow.

lines.zh: 两只气球缠在一起，我们就认了。
lines.en: Two balloons tangled, and we accepted it.

lines.zh: 我扇翅膀，它扇得更快。
lines.en: I flap. It flaps faster.

lines.zh: 我们在篷车底下搭了个小窝。
lines.en: We built a small nest under the wagon.

lines.zh: 它的气球是红的，我的是灰的。
lines.en: Its balloon is red. Mine is grey.

lines.zh: 我们不唱歌，只互相理毛。
lines.en: We don't sing. We only preen each other.

lines.zh: 两只小东西挤在一起，就不冷了。
lines.en: Two small creatures huddled, no longer cold.

lines.zh: 它把最后一颗浆果让给我。
lines.en: It gave me the last berry.

lines.zh: 我们绕着圈飞，绳子打了结。
lines.en: We flew in circles until our strings knotted.

lines.zh: 窝里铺的是芦苇穗和我的绒毛。
lines.en: The nest is lined with reed fluff and my down.

lines.zh: 以后气球就绑两根线了。
lines.en: From now on the balloon has two strings.

lines.zh: 我用爪子抓起一颗莓，差点掉了。
lines.en: I grab a berry with my claws and nearly drop it.

lines.zh: 亮亮的东西我都想带走。
lines.en: I want to carry away anything shiny.

lines.zh: 那颗扣子卡在气球线上了。
lines.en: That button got caught on the balloon string.

lines.zh: 我叼不动，只能拖着走。
lines.en: I can't lift it. I can only drag it.

lines.zh: 你把东西放低点，我够得着。
lines.en: Set it lower. Then I can reach.

lines.zh: 我把小石子藏进窝的角落。
lines.en: I hide a pebble in the corner of my nest.

lines.zh: 这个不能吃，但很好看。
lines.en: This isn't food, but it's pretty.

lines.zh: 东西一多，气球就往下沉。
lines.en: The more I carry, the lower the balloon sinks.

lines.zh: 你掉的线头，我收着当垫子。
lines.en: I keep the thread you dropped for bedding.

lines.zh: 我咬着它飞了两步就掉了。
lines.en: I carried it two flaps before dropping it.

lines.zh: 水里有东西动，我先盯着。
lines.en: Something moved in the water. I'm watching.

lines.zh: 那不是食物，是一条蛇，我僵住了。
lines.en: That's not food, it's a snake. I freeze.

lines.zh: 我听见草丛里在响，翅膀先竖起。
lines.en: Something rustles in the grass. My wings prick up.

lines.zh: 那只青蛙跳了，我追了半步。
lines.en: The frog jumped. I chased half a step.

lines.zh: 我把气球压低，藏进芦苇里。
lines.en: I lower the balloon and hide in the reeds.

lines.zh: 有影子掠过，是鸟，不是云。
lines.en: A shadow passed. A bird, not a cloud.

lines.zh: 我锁定那颗晃动的浆果。
lines.en: I lock onto the swaying berry.

lines.zh: 声音在左边，我偏过头去。
lines.en: The sound is left. I turn my head.

lines.zh: 不是危险，只是我好奇心大。
lines.en: Not danger. Just my curiosity.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，直到它先动。
lines.en: I watch it until it moves first.

lines.zh: 我跟着那只虫，飞得很低。
lines.en: I follow that bug, flying very low.

lines.zh: 它停，我也停，气球还在晃。
lines.en: It stops. I stop. The balloon still sways.

lines.zh: 我绕到它后面，翅膀不出声。
lines.en: I circle behind it, wings silent.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我的影子会吓跑它。
lines.en: Any closer and my shadow will scare it off.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面，等它再冒头。
lines.en: I watch the water, waiting for it to surface again.

lines.zh: 那点动静，值得我暂停打盹。
lines.en: That little movement is worth pausing my nap.

lines.zh: 我把线绕在枝上，稳住身子。
lines.en: I wrap the string on a branch to steady myself.

lines.zh: 它往左，我也往左偏。
lines.en: It goes left. I lean left too.

lines.zh: 我追得气喘，翅膀都热了。
lines.en: The chase has me panting and my wings hot.

lines.zh: 其实我只是想看清楚它。
lines.en: Honestly, I only want a closer look.

lines.zh: 我用头顶过去，气球在后面甩。
lines.en: I headbutt forward, the balloon whipping behind.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，但你退了一步。
lines.en: It's a light hit, but you stepped back.

lines.zh: 一啄下去，我的嘴麻了半边。
lines.en: One peck and half my beak went numb.

lines.zh: 别抓我的气球，我会拼命。
lines.en: Don't grab my balloon. I'll fight.

lines.zh: 我踢了你一脚，像丢了个小石子。
lines.en: I kicked you, like tossing a small pebble.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇你脸，这是警告。
lines.en: Wings in your face. That's a warning.

lines.zh: 我冲过去，又赶紧刹住。
lines.en: I charge, then brake hard.

lines.zh: 打不过我也要打，气球在看着。
lines.en: I'll fight even losing. The balloon is watching.

lines.zh: 我咬了你指尖，马上又放开。
lines.en: I nipped your fingertip, then let go fast.

lines.zh: 退开，我要护着这颗果子。
lines.en: Back off. I'm guarding this berry.

lines.zh: 袋子松开时，我先探出气球。
lines.en: When the sack opened, my balloon came out first.

lines.zh: 我从篷车的板缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I squeezed out between the wagon's planks.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾还没散，我已经在飞。
lines.en: The swamp mist hasn't cleared and I'm already flying.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋滚了两圈，裂开一条缝。
lines.en: The spawn egg rolled twice and cracked.

lines.zh: 我落在水洼边，抖了抖翅膀。
lines.en: I landed by the puddle and shook my wings.

lines.zh: 这地方有芦苇，适合藏气球。
lines.en: Reeds here. Good for hiding a balloon.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是雾，不是天。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was mist, not sky.

lines.zh: 绳子早就系好了，像生来就有。
lines.en: The string was already tied, as if born with me.

lines.zh: 我听见篷车的木头在响。
lines.en: I hear the wagon's wood creaking.

lines.zh: 别踩我，我刚学会站稳。
lines.en: Don't step on me. I just learned to stand.

lines.zh: 火苗靠近，气球发出焦味。
lines.en: Flame nears and the balloon smells scorched.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，气球还在上面。
lines.en: I fell from high, balloon still above me.

lines.zh: 水把我往下拽，气球浮着。
lines.en: Water pulls me down. The balloon floats.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹出好远，线还连着。
lines.en: The blast threw me far, string still attached.

lines.zh: 箭擦过气球，嘶了一声。
lines.en: An arrow grazed the balloon with a hiss.

lines.zh: 药水味让我打了好几个喷嚏。
lines.en: The potion smell made me sneeze repeatedly.

lines.zh: 我饿得抓不住绳子了。
lines.en: I'm so hungry I can't grip the string.

lines.zh: 雷声把我吓得钻进芦苇。
lines.en: Thunder scared me into the reeds.

lines.zh: 这里没有风，气球也不动了。
lines.en: No wind here. The balloon hangs still.
